bonuses.name: Stalking Shadow
bonuses.text: Striking Scorpions in a concealed position may start an encounter with a Stealth Score of 5, and may Move at full Speed without reducing their Stealth Score. They gain +2 bonus dice and +2 ED when making a Surprise Attack (+4 bonus dice and +4 ED in total).

bonuses.name: Intense Emotions
bonuses.text: This Threat takes a penalty of +1 DN to all Resolve Tests.

abilities.name: Mandiblasters
abilities.text: If a Striking Scorpion rolls a Wrath Critical on a melee attack Test against a creature Size Average or smaller, the target suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds in addition to the Critical Hit's effects.

options.name: Striking Scorpion Exarch
options.text: A Striking Scorpion Exarch has Weapon Skill 11 and 9 Wounds. They lose their Shuriken Pistol, and gain the equipment and bonuses below: Scorpion's Claw: 9 +5 ED / AP -3 / Brutal; Claw-Mounted Shuriken Catapult: 10 +1 ED / Range 6 - 12 - 18 / Salvo 3 / Assault, Rending (3); Champion: An Exarch may use Ruin Actions; Scorpion's Sting: Striking Scorpions within 10m of their Exarch inflict an extra 2 Mortal Wounds with their Mandiblasters (5 Mortal Wounds total).
